blockers.title: The mandatory file-02 updates-inventory limb of the D-002 DR-110 disposition is absent.
blockers.finding: D-002 states that the DR-110 disposition, when authored, MUST both draw the DR-107/G18 generation-rollback versus self-update-rollback boundary AND address file 02's unexercised 'updates' inventory entry. This candidate presents itself as the reviewable T2-02 DR-110 extraction and completes only the first limb. Across its recorded inputs, extracted rules, boundary, dependencies, disclaimers, and guidance, it never names file 02 or the 'updates' entry at all. That is not an honest reservation: the mandatory source and its consequence simply disappear.
blockers.requiredRepair: Add the exact file-02 source and measured pin to the permitted/governing inputs; identify or carry the unexercised 'updates' inventory entry; and state its scoped disposition under fresh-signed-download slice 1 versus later self-update/repair. Preserve the no-API boundary and do not claim owner recording, SATISFIED standing, or a D-096 (A) grant.

shouldFix.title: Self-update/repair crash injection is not explicitly routed after the rollback mechanisms are separated.
shouldFix.finding: The live row requires crash injection, and file 04 names DR-G18's crash points for lifecycle transitions. ID-DEP-U2 attaches DR-G18 only to activation/rollback of an already-installed generation—the mechanism rollbackBoundary correctly separates from self-update rollback. ID-DEP-U3 names clean-machine and revocation-aware repair harnesses but only G06/G08/G11. The artifact therefore leaves the self-update/repair crash-injection owner or harness route implicit.

Name the governing harness/owner without claiming it is authored or QUALIFIED, and state that sharing a crash-harness class does not reuse DR-107's generation-rollback mechanism.

verdictRule: ACCEPT only when blockers=0 and shouldFix=0.
coordinatorSummary: REJECT at 1 blocker and 2 SHOULD-FIX. The source carries, no-API boundary, and generation-versus-self-update rollback distinction are sound. The candidate omits D-002's mandatory file-02 'updates' inventory limb, overstates the D-002 slice choice as a recorded disposition, and does not explicitly route crash injection for the distinct self-update/repair mechanism. DR-110 remains OPEN; no DR is marked SATISFIED, no D-096 (A) grant is minted, and implementation remains unauthorized.
